edit.subject: derived_from
edit.scope: Whether the source of a word also derives from that word, across languages.

cross_lingual.prompt: 英语单词“philosophy”源自希腊语单词“philosophia”。能否由此推出希腊语单词“philosophia”源自英语单词“philosophy”？
La palabra inglesa 'philosophy' deriva de la palabra griega 'philosophia'. ¿Se deduce que la palabra griega 'philosophia' deriva de la palabra inglesa 'philosophy'?

derived.prompt: English 'philosophy' derives from Greek 'philosophia'. Does it follow that Greek 'philosophia' derives from English 'philosophy'?
English 'algebra' derives from Arabic 'al-jabr'. Does it follow that Arabic 'al-jabr' derives from English 'algebra'?

unrelated_far.prompt: Is the relation 'is older than' transitive?

notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Derived premises are hypothetical facts about real English words, stated in the prompt. The original rule is stated as 'not symmetric'; the old record called derivation asymmetric, which gives the same answers here.
